tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Find public posts that match a query. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, youtube, reddit, x, tiktok, instagram, threads, xiaohongshu, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: What is popular on the platform right now. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, reddit, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: One post by ID or URL, with full text and metrics. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, youtube, reddit, x, tiktok, instagram, threads, xiaohongshu, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: The replies under one post, flattened with depth. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, youtube, reddit, x, tiktok, instagram, threads, xiaohongshu, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: A public account: name, bio and counts. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, youtube, reddit, x, tiktok, instagram, threads, xiaohongshu, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_user_posts
tools.description: Recent public posts from one account. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: bluesky, hackernews, youtube, reddit, x, tiktok, instagram, threads, xiaohongshu, douyin. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The full spoken text of one video, with a timestamp for every line. Returns compact, cited results (each item has a url). Works on: youtube. Requires a prepaid API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your balance and last five calls. Free: use it to check that the API key works before making a charged call.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: Which platforms are live, which actions each supports, the price per call, and which fields each platform cannot provide.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_trending, get_post, get_comments, get_user, get_user_posts, get_transcript · Private data: search_posts, get_trending, get_post, get_comments, get_user, get_user_posts, get_transcript, get_account · Public sink: get_post, get_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_trending, get_post, get_comments, get_user, get_user_posts, get_transcript · Private data: search_posts, get_trending, get_post, get_comments, get_user, get_user_posts, get_transcript, get_account · Public sink: get_post, get_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
